hints.tr: `None` ve `""` ikisi de "yok" demektir: `if not expected or not sent: return False`.
hints.en: `None` and `""` both mean "missing": `if not expected or not sent: return False`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import hmac


def check(expected, sent):
    if not expected or not sent:
        return False
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, sent)

token = "tok-8f2a"
print(check(token, "tok-8f2a"))
print(check(token, "guess"))
print(check(None, None))
print(check("", ""))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
import hmac


def check(expected, sent):
    if not expected or not sent:
        return False
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected, sent)

token = "tok-8f2a"
print(check(token, "tok-8f2a"))
print(check(token, "guess"))
print(check(None, None))
print(check("", ""))
```
